# coolify_deployments (Data Source)

Deployments: without `application_uuid`, the currently queued/running deployments of the instance; with it, the deployment history of that application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Currently queued/running deployments on the instance.
data "coolify_deployments" "running" {}

# History of one application.
data "coolify_deployments" "web" {
  application_uuid = coolify_application.web.uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `application_uuid` (String) Restrict to one application's deployment history.

### Read-Only

- `deployments` (Attributes List) Deployments, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deployments))

<a id="nestedatt--deployments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deployments`

Read-Only:

- `application_name` (String) Application name.
- `commit` (String) Deployed commit SHA.
- `deployment_uuid` (String) Deployment UUID.
- `status` (String) queued, in_progress, finished, failed…
